collection.description: Strange ripples revive stories of a legendary creature living near the reeds.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Strange ripples revive stories of a legendary creature living near the reeds.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The ripples turn out to be ordinary fish.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The watchers see something they cannot identify.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (teen) notices the stories changed over generations.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The villagers avoid disturbing nesting animals.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child), a curious child, learns that mystery need not be chased.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Children invent a friendly reed monster.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (adult), a skeptical adult, volunteers to play its tail.
